notes: Ground truth is computed by executing gold_sql against the warehouse, so it cannot drift from the data. 'Revenue' means completed orders only (matches kpi_revenue_by_month). Every gold_sql must pass the agent's own validator and run under the read-only role, so each question is answerable within the agent's permissions.

sql_questions.question: What was total completed revenue in 2024?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue_usd)::numeric,2) AS total_revenue FROM fact_sales WHERE status='completed' AND order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01' LIMIT 1
mutants: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue_usd)::numeric,2) FROM fact_sales WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01' LIMIT 1

sql_questions.question: How many completed orders were placed in December 2023?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders FROM fact_sales WHERE status='completed' AND order_date >= '2023-12-01' AND order_date < '2024-01-01' LIMIT 1
mutants: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales WHERE order_date >= '2023-12-01' AND order_date < '2024-01-01' LIMIT 1

sql_questions.question: What was the total profit from completed orders in 2023?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(profit_usd)::numeric,2) AS total_profit FROM fact_sales WHERE status='completed' AND order_date >= '2023-01-01' AND order_date < '2024-01-01' LIMIT 1
mutants: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue_usd)::numeric,2) FROM fact_sales WHERE status='completed' AND order_date >= '2023-01-01' AND order_date < '2024-01-01' LIMIT 1

sql_questions.question: What are the top 5 countries by completed revenue across all years?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT country, ROUND(SUM(revenue_usd)::numeric,2) AS revenue FROM fact_sales WHERE status='completed' GROUP BY country ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5
mutants: SELECT country, ROUND(SUM(revenue_usd)::numeric,2) AS revenue FROM fact_sales WHERE status='completed' GROUP BY country ORDER BY revenue ASC LIMIT 5

sql_questions.question: How many customers do we have in each country?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM dim_customer_masked GROUP BY country ORDER BY customers DESC LIMIT 50
mutants: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM dim_customer_masked WHERE is_premium GROUP BY country LIMIT 50

sql_questions.question: How many premium customers are there?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS premium_customers FROM dim_customer_masked WHERE is_premium LIMIT 1
mutants: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_customer_masked LIMIT 1

sql_questions.question: What was completed revenue by sales channel in 2023?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT channel, ROUND(SUM(revenue_usd)::numeric,2) AS revenue FROM fact_sales WHERE status='completed' AND order_date >= '2023-01-01' AND order_date < '2024-01-01' GROUP BY channel LIMIT 50
mutants: SELECT channel, ROUND(SUM(revenue_usd)::numeric,2) FROM fact_sales WHERE order_date >= '2023-01-01' AND order_date < '2024-01-01' GROUP BY channel LIMIT 50

sql_questions.question: Which 5 products sold the most units in completed orders?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS units FROM fact_sales WHERE status='completed' GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY units DESC, product_id LIMIT 5
mutants: SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS units FROM fact_sales WHERE status='completed' GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY units DESC, product_id LIMIT 5

sql_questions.question: How many orders were refunded?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS refunded_orders FROM fact_sales WHERE status='refunded' LIMIT 1
mutants: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales WHERE status='cancelled' LIMIT 1

sql_questions.question: What is the average discount percentage on completed orders that actually had a discount applied?
sql_questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(discount_pct)::numeric,3) AS avg_discount_pct FROM fact_sales WHERE status='completed' AND discount_pct > 0 LIMIT 1
mutants: SELECT ROUND(AVG(discount_pct)::numeric,3) FROM fact_sales WHERE status='completed' LIMIT 1

analytics_questions.question: Which month had the highest completed revenue, and how much was it?
analytics_questions.gold_sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(month,'YYYY-MM') AS month, ROUND(total_revenue::numeric,2) AS revenue FROM kpi_revenue_by_month ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1
mutants: SELECT TO_CHAR(month,'YYYY-MM'), ROUND(total_revenue::numeric,2) FROM kpi_revenue_by_month ORDER BY total_revenue ASC LIMIT 1

analytics_questions.question: What was the percentage change in completed revenue from November 2024 to December 2024?
analytics_questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(((dec.total_revenue - nov.total_revenue) / nov.total_revenue * 100)::numeric,2) AS pct_change FROM kpi_revenue_by_month dec, kpi_revenue_by_month nov WHERE dec.month = '2024-12-01' AND nov.month = '2024-11-01' LIMIT 1
mutants: SELECT ROUND(((nov.total_revenue - dec.total_revenue) / dec.total_revenue * 100)::numeric,2) FROM kpi_revenue_by_month dec, kpi_revenue_by_month nov WHERE dec.month = '2024-12-01' AND nov.month = '2024-11-01' LIMIT 1

analytics_questions.question: What was completed revenue in each quarter of 2023?
analytics_questions.gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM month)::int AS quarter, ROUND(SUM(total_revenue)::numeric,2) AS revenue FROM kpi_revenue_by_month WHERE month >= '2023-01-01' AND month < '2024-01-01' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 4
mutants: SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM month)::int, ROUND(AVG(total_revenue)::numeric,2) FROM kpi_revenue_by_month WHERE month >= '2023-01-01' AND month < '2024-01-01' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 4

analytics_questions.question: What is the average order value (completed revenue per completed order) for each year?
analytics_questions.gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date)::int AS year, ROUND((SUM(revenue_usd)/COUNT(*))::numeric,2) AS aov FROM fact_sales WHERE status='completed' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 5
mutants: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date)::int, ROUND((SUM(revenue_usd)/COUNT(*))::numeric,2) FROM fact_sales GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 5

analytics_questions.question: What is the profit margin (profit divided by revenue, in percent) by product category on completed orders?
analytics_questions.gold_sql: SELECT category, ROUND((SUM(profit_usd)/SUM(revenue_usd)*100)::numeric,2) AS margin_pct FROM fact_sales WHERE status='completed' GROUP BY category LIMIT 20
mutants: SELECT category, ROUND((SUM(profit_usd)/SUM(cost_usd)*100)::numeric,2) FROM fact_sales WHERE status='completed' GROUP BY category LIMIT 20

analytics_questions.question: Which month in 2024 had the most completed orders?
analytics_questions.gold_sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(month,'YYYY-MM') AS month, order_count FROM kpi_revenue_by_month WHERE month >= '2024-01-01' ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 1
mutants: SELECT TO_CHAR(month,'YYYY-MM'), order_count FROM kpi_revenue_by_month WHERE month >= '2024-01-01' ORDER BY order_count ASC LIMIT 1

multi_table_questions.question: Which product category has the highest return rate, and what is it?
multi_table_questions.gold_sql: SELECT category, return_rate_pct FROM kpi_returns_rate_by_category ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC LIMIT 1
mutants: SELECT category, return_rate_pct FROM kpi_returns_rate_by_category ORDER BY return_rate_pct ASC LIMIT 1

multi_table_questions.question: Compare total completed revenue from premium and non-premium customers.
multi_table_questions.gold_sql: SELECT c.is_premium, ROUND(SUM(s.revenue_usd)::numeric,2) AS revenue FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_customer_masked c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE s.status='completed' GROUP BY c.is_premium LIMIT 2
mutants: SELECT c.is_premium, ROUND(AVG(s.revenue_usd)::numeric,2) FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_customer_masked c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE s.status='completed' GROUP BY c.is_premium LIMIT 2

multi_table_questions.question: How many products are currently at or below their reorder point?
multi_table_questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS at_risk FROM kpi_inventory_turnover WHERE at_reorder_risk LIMIT 1
mutants: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kpi_inventory_turnover WHERE NOT at_reorder_risk LIMIT 1

multi_table_questions.question: Which 3 marketing channels had the best return on ad spend (total revenue divided by total spend) in 2024?
multi_table_questions.gold_sql: SELECT channel, ROUND((SUM(actual_revenue_usd)/SUM(spend_usd))::numeric,2) AS roas FROM fact_marketing_spend WHERE year_month LIKE '2024-%' GROUP BY channel ORDER BY roas DESC LIMIT 3
mutants: SELECT channel, ROUND((SUM(actual_revenue_usd)/SUM(spend_usd))::numeric,2) FROM fact_marketing_spend WHERE year_month LIKE '2023-%' GROUP BY channel ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

multi_table_questions.question: What are the top 5 return reasons by total refund amount?
multi_table_questions.gold_sql: SELECT reason, ROUND(SUM(refund_amount_usd)::numeric,2) AS refunded FROM fact_returns GROUP BY reason ORDER BY refunded DESC LIMIT 5
mutants: SELECT reason, COUNT(*) AS n FROM fact_returns GROUP BY reason ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5

multi_table_questions.question: What are the top 5 Electronics products by completed revenue?
multi_table_questions.gold_sql: SELECT s.product_id, ROUND(SUM(s.revenue_usd)::numeric,2) AS revenue FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_product p ON s.product_id = p.product_id WHERE s.status='completed' AND p.category='Electronics' GROUP BY s.product_id ORDER BY revenue DESC, s.product_id LIMIT 5
mutants: SELECT s.product_id, ROUND(SUM(s.revenue_usd)::numeric,2) FROM fact_sales s JOIN dim_product p ON s.product_id = p.product_id WHERE s.status='completed' AND p.category='Books' GROUP BY s.product_id ORDER BY 2 DESC, s.product_id LIMIT 5

multi_table_questions.question: How many customers who registered in 2022 placed at least one completed order in 2024?
multi_table_questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customers FROM dim_customer_masked c JOIN fact_sales s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.registration_date >= '2022-01-01' AND c.registration_date < '2023-01-01' AND s.status='completed' AND s.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND s.order_date < '2025-01-01' LIMIT 1
mutants: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) FROM dim_customer_masked c JOIN fact_sales s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.registration_date >= '2022-01-01' AND c.registration_date < '2023-01-01' LIMIT 1

multi_table_questions.question: How many primary-supplier products are rated HIGH supplier risk?
multi_table_questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_risk FROM kpi_supplier_risk WHERE supplier_risk_level='HIGH' LIMIT 1
mutants: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kpi_supplier_risk WHERE supplier_risk_level='MEDIUM' LIMIT 1

multi_table_questions.question: What share of completed 2024 revenue came from each product category? Give percentages.
multi_table_questions.gold_sql: SELECT category, ROUND((SUM(revenue_usd)/SUM(SUM(revenue_usd)) OVER () * 100)::numeric,2) AS share_pct FROM fact_sales WHERE status='completed' AND order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY category LIMIT 20
mutants: SELECT category, ROUND((SUM(revenue_usd)/SUM(SUM(revenue_usd)) OVER () * 100)::numeric,2) FROM fact_sales WHERE status='completed' AND order_date >= '2023-01-01' AND order_date < '2024-01-01' GROUP BY category LIMIT 20

multi_table_questions.question: How many returns were filed for Clothing products?
multi_table_questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS returns FROM fact_returns r JOIN dim_product p ON r.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category='Clothing' LIMIT 1
mutants: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_returns r JOIN dim_product p ON r.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category='Books' LIMIT 1
